youtube.title: Mera profile kaafi hai kya? Real admits dekho
youtube.description:
Mera profile kaafi hai kya? Har applicant ka pehla sawaal.

Seniors bolte hain "ho jayega", relatives bolte hain "bahut competition hai", aur Google pe sirf opinions.

EduAbroad ka Admit Finder dikhata hai real students ke real profiles: unka GPA, GRE, IELTS ya TOEFL, work experience, aur final result. Accepted bhi, rejected bhi. University, course, intake aur work experience se filter karo, aur apne jaise profiles dhundo.

Free hai. Login ki zaroorat nahi.
👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com/admit-finder

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
